bull_case: Management divested the Apps business to concentrate on advertising, scaled Axon, and used abundant FCF for large repurchases that reduced share count. Execution has been unusually strong.
bear_case: Founder control is substantial, the company is a Nasdaq controlled company, and aggressive buybacks at high valuation can create governance and capital-allocation risk if growth normalizes.
thesis: Management execution and strategic allocation are strong, but governance prevents an exceptional score. The Apps divestiture concentrated resources on the higher-return advertising platform, while large buybacks more than offset SBC. FY2025 ICFR and audit opinions were clean. However, Class B carries 20 votes per share and the voting-agreement parties held about 67% of voting power at year-end, limiting minority influence and increasing key-person/governance risk.

evidence.claim: The Apps Business was divested in June 2025 to dedicate resources to the advertising business.
evidence.value: Apps Business divestiture and strategic focus

evidence.claim: 2025 repurchases totaled about $2.2B; H1 2026 common-stock repurchases were $1.533B.
FY2025 ICFR was effective and Deloitte issued unqualified opinions on financial statements and ICFR.
Class B has 20 votes per share and voting-agreement parties held about 67% of voting power at Dec. 31, 2025.

counterevidence: Founder control reduces minority shareholder influence and board accountability.
Buybacks at elevated market prices can lower future returns if intrinsic value is overestimated.
Key-person dependence on Adam Foroughi is explicitly disclosed.
Rapid strategic expansion can create execution risk despite recent success.
unknowns: Capital-allocation policy if valuation rises above intrinsic value.

uncertainties.rationale: Divestiture and repurchases are economically coherent, though buyback price discipline remains important.
Reporting is clean but controlled-company voting concentration is a structural governance discount.
Recent strategic focus and operating results demonstrate strong execution.

falsifiers: Management repurchases heavily above intrinsic value while operating performance weakens.
Governance concentration leads to related-party or disclosure problems.
New verticals consume capital without measurable FCF/share returns.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Clean Deloitte audit and effective ICFR support reporting integrity; governance concentration is a risk but not evidence of dishonesty.

key_kpis.name: FCF/share after buybacks
key_kpis.threshold: Per-share value compounds faster than enterprise FCF

subscores.rationale: Strategic divestiture, internal reinvestment and repurchases have created strong per-share economics.
Financial reporting is strong, but controlled-company voting concentration materially weakens governance.
Management has adapted the portfolio and scaled the advertising platform exceptionally well.
